_doc: Interiors by the hour, the season and what has happened (world/innerMap/interiorState.js): a layer laid over the planned interior each time it is shown and again each hour while you are inside, taken off on leaving; never saved, never written into the plan. Hours are [from, to) spans; a 'to' past 24 runs on past midnight (26 = 2 at night). 'kinds' sorts the building types (the rest go by data/architecture.json wealth.floors: work, hall, else home). 'fires' is when each kind keeps its hearths lit (fireplace, oven, cauldron) — 'winter' replaces 'lit' in winter, 'banked' is when a fire not lit is banked for the night rather than out; the forge and the bakery's oven keep their trade's hours (data/townScenes.json interiors smithy/bakery hours, else these). 'candles' when candles are lit, 'shutters' when windows are shut. 'meals' lays the table at breakfast and supper in homes and halls; 'tavern' fills the tables with mugs as the tavern fills (data/townScenes.json interiors.tavern.crowdByHour) and clears them when it is near empty. 'marks': what raids (settlement.lastRaidedDay), a sack (world/townMarks.js 'sack' marks), plague looting (settlement.plague.looted) and a fire (a 'scorched' building, a fire mark nearby) leave — broken furniture, pieces carried off, decor stripped, soot — fading over their days; a building rebuilt since is clean. 'wealth': a town poorer than when its houses were built strips their finery, a richer one adds to it. 'winter': firewood by the hearths (never shutting a tile off from the door), furs on the beds. 'feast': garlands on the walls and extra food on midwinter, the harvest fair and holy days.
